body:
Companion to SHANKPIT@d567232. New internal/shankpit.Character.Kit/CharacterExport.Kit + AIKit* consts, range-validated at save time. New 'Kit (visual model)' dropdown in NOCK's CharacterInspector (ShankpitLevelEditor.tsx), defaulting new characters to Auto -- every pre-existing character decodes to AIKitAuto unchanged, no migration needed (stored in the existing Character JSON blob). IDUNA@1548de9. Verified: go build/vet/test ./... clean (4 new/updated tests), tsc -b && vite build clean, confirmed the new option labels landed in the rebuilt dist/ bundle. Honest gap: this sandbox has no access to the live iduna.service (no systemd/D-Bus) so the running production binary was NOT rebuilt/restarted this session -- code is pushed to main, deployment is a separate, not-yet-done step.

⚓ ☃
title: Character kit (visual model) authoring UI + schema, S492
